'''Council 436''' was a [[farm]]ing [[city|settlement]] on the agricultural world [[Mina-Rau]]. Following the [[Ferrix]] [[Ferrix Riot|uprising]] in [[5 BBY]] [[Bix Caleen]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], [[B2EMO]], [[Wilmon Paak]] and [[Brasso]] all relocated to Council 436.

==Description==
Located on the [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]],<ref name="General Store Databank">{{Databank|mina-rau-general-store|Mina-Rau General Store}}</ref> the settlement consisted of homes built into the side of an earthen mound several stories high. The numberals "436" were written large in [[Aurebesh]] on the side of the mound, which was surrounded by flatland filled with fields of [[grain]] as well as several buildings at the base. The surrounding fields included [[irrigation tower]]s and [[mega silo]]s. The settlement also made use of [[mobil-haus]] shetlers to house [[Technician|mechanics]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==History==
By [[4 BBY]], a human named [[Kellen]] operated a [[Mina-Rau General Store|general store]] at 436 with his wife, [[Aneth]] and daughter [[Beela]].<ref name="Kellen Databank">{{Databank|kellen|Kellen}}</ref> [[Bix Caleen]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], [[B2EMO]], [[Wilmon Paak]] and [[Brasso]] made a life for themselves at 436<ref name="One Year Later" />  after being apart of an [[Ferrix Riot|uprising]] against the [[Galactic Empire]] on their home planet of [[Ferrix]].<ref name="Rix Road">{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}}</ref> In 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the Empire began an [[Imperial Supply Census]] on Mina-Rau, eventually making their way to Council 436. A brief [[Skirmish on Mina-Rau|skirmish]] bewteen the Ferrix group and members of the Empire resulted in damage to a mega silo and the [[death]] of Brasso and a number of imperials. Following the skirmish, Caleen, Andor and Paak fled the planet,<ref name="One Year Later" /> however Caleen later returned to raise [[Bix Caleen's child|her child]] by [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Jedha Kyber Erso">{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Council 436 appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing the in the first episode "[[One Year Later]]," which was released on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="One Year Later" />
